identity.name: Submariner
identity.one_liner: The 2012-2020 no-date Submariner: ceramic bezel, maxi case, caliber 3130.

provenance_events.description: Rolex updates the no-date Submariner to the 114060 — 40mm, ceramic bezel, caliber 3130. The reference runs 2012-2020 before being replaced by the 124060. Becomes the most-cited modern Submariner baseline.

narrative.story: The 114060 brought the no-date Sub into the ceramic era two years after the Date version, pairing Cerachrom and the Super Case with the time-only 3130. Its eight-year run made it the reference many collectors call the last tool-simple Sub: 40mm, no cyclops, solid-link bracelet with Glidelock.
narrative.collector_notes: Values sit below the 116610LN. There are no dial or bezel variants to chase within the reference, so condition drives the price.
